name: Disfiguring Transformation
body:
Benefit(s): Whenever you apply a graft, piece of cybertech, or polymorph effect to a creature, you may warp their appearance in some manner that makes them unpleasant to gaze on. For as long as they are affected, the target creature takes a -4 penalty to all Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks.
